item.description:

item.title: Josh Jacobs: Set for surgery on finger Friday
item.description:
Jacobs will undergo finger surgery Friday, and the Packers will have a better sense of his recovery timetable afterward, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

item.title: Denzel Boston: Says toe feels better
item.description:
Boston (toe) said Thursday that he's hoping to return to practice and "definitely feel(s) better" after sitting out Wednesday's practice, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.
